name: nagarai-monorepo
description: Root launcher for NagarAI — ml-service (FastAPI), server (Express), client (Vite/React).

scripts.install:all: npm install && pip install -r ml-service/requirements.txt && npm --prefix nagarai/server install && npm --prefix nagarai/client install
scripts.seed: npm --prefix nagarai/server run seed && npm --prefix nagarai/server run seed:real-bins && npm --prefix nagarai/server run create:admin
